articles.title: India Is Now Buying Oil from Four Continents. The Old Supply Chain Is Gone.

articles.title: 23 Parties Will Meet Today. The DMK Won't Be There. The INDIA Bloc Has Never Looked This Fragile.

articles.title: Mamata Banerjee's Party Is Fracturing. MLAs Are Revolting, Leaders Are in Jail, and Crowds Are Throwing Eggs.
articles.excerpt: The Trinamool Congress is facing its worst internal crisis since coming to power in 2011.
